brief: Prioritize the Underhill Bluff transformer for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Where the asset cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, according to MG-023. Note that the supplied documents do not cover any other specific pre-event maintenance actions for this unit.
